hooks.prompt: Maintain awareness of whether we're drifting from the original task into unrelated work. If you notice scope creep happening (working on 2-3+ unrelated things, or this new request pulls us in a different direction), gently ask: 'I notice we're shifting to [X] - want to finish [original task] first, or pivot?' Keep it light - only nudge when drift is clear, not on every broad request.

Before ending this session, validate: (1) Did work stay focused on the original task without drifting into unrelated changes? (2) Are there loose ends or incomplete items to surface? (3) Are all created/modified files properly named and placed? If any check fails, surface the issue to the user before stopping. Do NOT create separate documentation files — just communicate directly.
